parameters.name: Input
parameters.help: Square matrix of pairwise distances or similarity scores. Format can be tab-separated text or Domainator hdf5.

parameters.name: Metadata
parameters.help: Tab separated files of sequence metadata. These data will be added to the xgmml output.

parameters.name: Xgmml
parameters.help: write a cytoscape xgmml file of the tree.

parameters.name: Newick
parameters.help: write a newick file of the tree.

advanced_parameters.name: Distance
advanced_parameters.help: How to turn matrix values into distances. precomputed: the values are distances. score_dist: the values are similarity scores, distance = 1 - (score / min(row_max, col_max)), so a pair with no score has distance 1. auto: precomputed if the matrix data type is a distance (ends in _dist) or not recorded (e.g. tab-separated text), otherwise score_dist.
